productCandidate.meaning: Exact runnable merge of current VexLife-Prod main with Claude's seven-scope consolidated Product candidate.

question: Can one source-derived Experience Graph explain the current Product plus Claude's UI/language/voice/identity changes while preserving human journeys and refusing to call a route end-to-end complete before its execution proof exists?
screenLensBoundary: Screen Lens may project the result; it does not own or repair Experience Graph semantic truth in this experiment.

mechanicalProjectionReuse.observation: The only late-main path consumed by the mechanical graph changed Context Profile input-budget calculation only; it did not change the extractor-read Intent fields, Send captures, admission gates, or Receipt-field flow.
